equation_request.abstract: We propose a protocol to construct the 35 $f$-controlled phase gates of a three-qubit refined Deutsch-Jozsa (DJ) algorithm, by using single-qubit $\sigma_{z}$ gates, two-qubit controlled phase gates, and two-target-qubit controlled phase gates. Using this protocol, we discuss how to implement the three-qubit refined DJ algorithm with superconducting transmon qutrits resonantly coupled to a single cavity. Our numerical calculation shows that implementation of this quantum algorithm is feasible within the present circuit QED technique. The experimental realization of this algorithm would be an important step toward more complex quantum computation in circuit QED.

specification.problem: Three-qubit refined Deutsch-Jozsa: apply H^3, a diagonal phase oracle U_f=sum_x (-1)^{f(x)}|x><x| (placeholder, one query), H^3, then read the output distribution |hat F(s)|^2 to identify the function class. Also give a Z/CZ/CCZ decomposition of each of the 35 phase gates (the abstract's protocol contribution).
specification.reconstruction_scope: Ideal qubit-subspace statevector instance with 3 qubits, no ancilla, 1 oracle query. Out of scope: transmon qutrits, cavity coupling, two-target controlled-phase hardware pulses, numerical circuit QED simulation, and the paper's exact gate sequences for each of the 35 gates.

symbols.meaning: computational basis index; qubit i holds bit x_i, Qiskit little-endian

equations.label: Phase oracle
equations.description: f-controlled phase gate acting diagonally on three qubits
equations.justification: The abstract names f-controlled phase gates as the objects constructed; the diagonal +-1 form is the standard interpretation.
assumptions: Phase kickback convention with no ancilla

equations.label: Output amplitudes
equations.description: Final amplitude on outcome s; the probability is |\hat F(s)|^2

equations.label: ANF gate decomposition
equations.description: Phase oracle as product of Z (|S|=1), CZ (|S|=2), CCZ (|S|=3) gates; constant term a_empty is a global phase
equations.justification: A standard ANF-based diagonal synthesis, a proposed construction consistent with the abstract's use of Z and controlled-phase gates; not the paper's specific protocol.
assumptions: Standard CCZ used in place of two-target controlled-phase gate
Balanced f has ANF degree at most 2 for 3 variables, so CCZ is not needed

equations.label: Class readout
equations.description: Post-processing maps the measured distribution to a Walsh-support class; functions with equal spectra are not separated
equations.justification: Defines refined readout from the sketch; the paper's exact refined-DJ criterion is not in the abstract.

steps.description: Apply H on all three qubits.
Apply the opaque diagonal oracle placeholder U_f on qubits 0,1,2 (one query).
Apply H on all three qubits.
Measure all 3 qubits (only for counts tasks); the string is s with the last character = qubit 0.

specification.measurement: Measure q0,q1,q2 into c0,c1,c2; the counts key reversed gives s_0 s_1 s_2. Omit measurements if the runner reads the statevector.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Estimate P(s) from counts. Declare constant if only 000 appears. Otherwise declare balanced and report the support of P as the Walsh class.
assumptions: Oracle supplied as a diagonal phase gate with no ancilla
Qutrit and cavity hardware abstracted to ideal qubits
Qiskit-standard Z, CZ, CCZ available for the local synthesis of test oracles
missing_information: Paper's explicit gate sequences for the 35 phase gates
Exact refined-DJ discrimination criterion among the 35 functions
Qutrit encoding and cavity pulse details
